title: Ben Rich says the math in Maxwell's equations is a little off

tellings.quote: even going back to the '9s, Ben Rich saying there was some math in Maxwell's equations that was a little off.

plain: In the 1990s, Ben Rich, who ran Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the company Lockheed, said that some of the math in Maxwell's equations, the basic equations of electricity and magnetism, was "a little off." Michels mentions this himself, without giving a source, as a hint that insiders believed there was physics beyond what textbooks teach.
